about_the_game:
Welcome to Cyyer City, a dynamic open-world pixel-art MMO! In this living city, NPCs don't just follow scripts - they think, evolve and interact with the world like real citizens.

🏙️ A Living City - All NPCs have a daily routine, emotions, friendships and goals. They go to work, hang out with friends, start rivalries and even react to in-game events!

Endless activities - Race in kart tournaments, take part in paintball battles, escape mysterious rooms and take part in exciting mini-games to earn rewards and customize your avatar.

🕵️ Secrets and Mysteries - Uncover hidden stories in the Old District, enter secret laboratories and solve exciting events all over the city.

Online multiplayer - Find friends, trade items, complete cooperative missions or explore the city together! Community is at the heart of Cyyer City.

Your story, your path - Are you going to be a business tycoon, a street artist or an underground racer? Your choices shape your adventure!

Join Cyyer City and experience a living pixel-art world, where each player and NPC creates their own unique journey! 🚀

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Required for online mode

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 ou Intel Core i5 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / AMD Radeon Pro 560X / Intel Iris Plus Graphics 655
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Required for online mode

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
